title: What to look out for on Club World Cup 2025 day 7️⃣
content:
The group stage of the FIFA Club World Cup is ramping up with the second round of matches now well underway.

Here's what to look out for from today's action in the United States.

You can sign up to DAZN to watch every FIFA Club World Cup game for free.

Portuguese giants Benfica and Auckland City kick things off first in group C which will be followed by Chelsea's meeting with Brazilian side Flamengo in group D.

Los Angeles FC are in action against ES Tunis while Bayern Munich are set to face Boca Juniors.

📸 Alex Grimm - 2025 Getty Images

Bayern Munich started their Club World Cup campaign with a 10-0 thumping of Auckland City last time out, with second half substitute Jamal Musiala bagging a hat-trick in the space of 17 minutes.

Boca Juniors will present an even sterner test for the German champions, but the creative attacking midfielder will have the opportunity to make his mark if he plays from the start.

📸 Dylan Buell - 2025 Getty Images

Flamengo will hope to cause an upset when they face Premier League side Chelsea, with midfielder Jorginho set to take on his former club.

📸 Dylan Buell - 2025 Getty Images
summary:
Here are 3-5 bullet points summarizing the article:

• The FIFA Club World Cup group stage continues today with four matches in the United States, featuring teams such as Benfica, Auckland City, Chelsea, Flamengo, LAFC, ES Tunis, Bayern Munich, and Boca Juniors.
• Bayern Munich, who thrashed Auckland City 10-0 in their previous match, will face a tougher test against Boca Juniors, with midfielder Jamal Musiala looking to make an impact from the start.
• Flamengo will attempt to pull off an upset against Premier League side Chelsea, with midfielder Jorginho facing his former club.
• The matches can be streamed for free with a DAZN subscription.
